'''Revaak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] operating on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He guarded a Republic vault named the [[Steelfast Data Haven]] and was able to successfully repel an attack by [[Arak Malkan]] and his men. However, he was defeated and killed in the subsequent attack.<ref name="TOR" />
